notes.title: Special Promo for Launch !
notes.notes:
To celebrate the launch of [b]A Song In The Void[/b], we'll be doing a special promo !

On release (tomorrow), you'll have the chance to get the game at a reduced price. So get one, get five, get ten for the whole family !

notes.title: Release date : March 15th 2019
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

After participating in a few events, including an indigame festival (Indie Game Nation) we helped organize, we're back at the studio and in the big final rush. We're debugging, optimizing and running around, but we'll be ready !

So here it is : [b]A Song In The Void will be released on March the 15th ![/b]

The game will be available on PC, and we're doing our best to get it on Mac at the same time.

Back into the fray !

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31271557/d6e1ed57735b83921fc93950759c95be19b9115c.png[/img]

notes.title: We were at the Japan Expo !
notes.notes:
It was fun, it was exhausting, we loved it. The people were lovely (many in cosplay), our fellow indies were fantastic, the feedback was awesome and all the 3d printed goodies are gone ! Here are some photos to give you a taste, videos are coming later. check us out on facebook if you want to see more.

notes.title: Gamers Assembly @Poitiers !
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

A Song in the Void was slumming it at the Gamers Assembly 2018 in Poitiers :)
Lots of wonderful contacts, a very motivated crowd!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31271557/19c95da66c5f8ae88d1a36919bd12cab1206c09b.jpg[/img]

We unleashed our first speed run of an arena in the third island with magma and crumbling platforms. Very excited to have been part of the Indy Vibe and discovering new games in the Independant scene.

Check out the video link below for a little preview.
[url=https://youtu.be/UJ4KnjDoy5E] [/url]

Thanks to all who played, and congratulations on those who won!

The Team

notes.title: Fresh from the Toulouse Game Show !!!
notes.notes:
Hi to all of you Steamers!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31271557/96087e1ae006e39619abb98e1efeaf8e109e4807.jpg[/img]
We've just come back from the Toulouse Game Show (a big videogames event in the South of France). It was a wonderful experience, meeting people from the industry and also getting throngs of people trying the game and giving us feedback on our little Alpha!

More than 160,000 visitors came during the two days of the convention, and we were happy to see people testing the game. 

More to come soon, right Christmas !!!
